title: Commit orbit collection flashlight workflow
objective: Review the approved orbit collection implementation diff and create an appropriate local commit without pushing.
instructions: Inspect git status and diff before committing. Do not push.
Create a local commit for the approved orbit collection feature and repairs if the diff is coherent. Suggested message: Add flashlight orbit collection workflow.

Include the implementation, README, example light settings, validation tests, and .gitignore changes. Avoid mixing unrelated pre-existing generated Control Tower artifacts into the product-code commit unless project convention requires them; report what was included/excluded.
Run or report already-run non-simulator validation from Inspector; do not run simulator-dependent commands.
If the worktree contains unrelated dirty files, leave them untouched and report them.

artifacts: Orbit collection repair verified: setting output deletion is now guarded by reserved/hidden/path-like name rejection and realpath/commonpath containment before shutil.rmtree.

expected_outputs: ResultPacket with commit hash if created, files included, tests/validation status, remaining dirty worktree items, branch/ahead status, and whether push was intentionally skipped.
definition_of_done: Git status and diff are inspected.
Approved feature changes are committed locally or a clear blocker is reported.
